audit.reasoning: (1) Quote: verbatim confirmed in the primary source, Braga 1992 p. 41 sec. 3.1 (file fetched sources now; nothing was held before). (2) Deciding source: a 1992 first-hand phonology MA thesis by the language's sole specialist, restated by her in print in 1995 ('não é contrastivo; tem função demarcativa recaindo sempre na última sílaba') and consistent with every stress-marked transcription in her 2005 doctoral grammar; Glottolog and web search show no competing or later phonology/prosody/instrumental work on Makurap, so this is the best available. (3) Coding 'fixed-dominant, final (01 001 0001 00001)' matches the source; the catalog's convention codes bare 'always final' scan-tier statements as fixed-dominant rather than fixed-strict (cf. Jehai, Manchu, Warázu), so no recode. (4) Action: fill the empty grade/loc fields — cite 'Braga 1992: 41 (cap. I, sec. 3.1)' plus 'Braga 1995: Moara 4, p. 16' a

sources.citation: Braga 1992, A fonologia segmental e aspectos morfofonológicos da língua Makurap (Tupi), MA thesis UNICAMP, sec. 3.1 ACENTO (PDF downloaded from etnolinguistica.org)
sources.quote: o acento sempre recai na última sílaba da palavra.

sources.citation: Braga, Alzerinda de Oliveira. 2005. Aspects morphosyntaxiques de la langue makurap (tupi). Thèse de doctorat, Université de Toulouse-Le Mirail. 255 pp. (etnolinguistica.org scanned copy)
sources.quote: No stress rule stated (morphosyntax thesis; phonology deferred to Braga 1992). Phonetic transcriptions in the orthography tables consistently mark final stress: nmeto [mbue'to], pera [pe'ra], titi [ti'ti], ngeat [ge'at], marera [bare'ra], paya [pa'yo]. p. 87: tonic personal pronouns 'sont phonologiquement et morphosyntaxiquement indépendants et ... portent un accent', clitic pronouns are phonologically dependent on the following word.
sources.locator: Introduction sec. 3 'La présentation des exemples', pp. 19-21 (grapheme/phone tables); p. 87 sec. 5.1.1
sources.note: Glottolog's top-ranked (grammar) item; checked: no stress section, but transcriptions mark final stress and p. 87 gives tonic-vs-clitic pronoun accent facts useful if a stress DOMAIN field is ever coded (currently UNCODED).

sources.citation: Braga, Alzerinda de Oliveira. 1992. A fonologia segmental e aspectos morfofonológicos da língua Makurap (Tupi). Dissertação de Mestrado, Universidade Estadual de Campinas. 77 pp. (UFPA repository copy)
sources.quote: 'O acento é fixo e recai sobre a última sílaba da palavra.' ... 3.1 ACENTO: 'O acento sempre recai na última sílaba da palavra.' (examples 'lagarta', 'lamparina', 'mosca', 'cascavel', all transcribed with final stress). Also notes only duration is contrastive among suprasegmentals; tone's role unknown.
sources.locator: printed p. 41 (PDF p. 42), Cap. I sec. 3 'Supra-segmentos' and sec. 3.1 'Acento'
sources.note: The deciding source itself was not held (held list empty; etnolinguistica link dead, HTTP 500); fetched sources the UFPA repository copy and confirmed the quote at p. 41.

sources.citation: Braga, Alzerinda de Oliveira. 1995. A fonologia segmental e aspectos morfofonológicos da língua Makurap (Tupi). Moara – Revista dos Cursos de Pós-Graduação em Letras (UFPA, Belém) n. 4: 7-22. DOI 10.18542/moara.v3i04.3535 (image-only PDF; scanned, tesseract por 300 dpi)
sources.quote: 'O acento não é contrastivo; tem função demarcativa recaindo sempre na última sílaba da palavra.' (author's revised 1995 restatement of the thesis analysis; revision concerns nasal phonemes, not stress).
sources.locator: PDF p. 6 (running head p. 16), end of the syllable-structure section immediately before sec. 5 'Processos morfofonológicos'
sources.note: Author's published, revised restatement of the thesis; adds that stress is non-contrastive and demarcative, always final — a citable journal locus to pair with the thesis.
